decisions.rationale: "Macular dystrophy" is a generic term for a family of distinct inherited macular dystrophies rather than one single defined disease, so it is treated as a Disease Class.

decisions.rationale: In the Background, "macular dystrophy" refers to the general category of progressive macular dystrophies that the families exhibit, which is a family of diseases, so it is a Disease Class. It is not a modifier here.

In the Conclusion, "a macular dystrophy" is used as a noun for the disease category in which rds mutations are expressed. It is a generic class term, not a single specific disease, so it is a Disease Class.
